action.objective: Verify Rf2-g2, the broad-search suggestion, before committing.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gives Rf2-g2 the top exact score (-202), but no candidate is verified. The reserved verification budget (2000 nodes) is available for this move. Rf2-g2 avoids returning the rook home, keeps it active on g2, and does not hang material immediately. Use the reserved allowance to complete a single-candidate search at the maximum depth of 4 to obtain safety/tactical evidence before choosing a final move.
